name: Flagsmith (Self-Hosted)
description: Deploy Flagsmith, the open-source feature flag and remote config service. Runs the official image on ECS Fargate behind a load balancer — API and dashboard, plus a task processor — with a managed RDS PostgreSQL database (~$110/mo).

cpu.title: Task CPU
cpu.description: Fargate CPU units for the Flagsmith API task (256 = 0.25 vCPU).

memoryMiB.title: Task Memory (MiB)
memoryMiB.description: Fargate memory for the Flagsmith API task. Must suit the CPU: 256 → 512–2048, 512 → 1024–4096, 1024 → 2048–4096, 2048 → 4096.

desiredCount.title: Tasks
desiredCount.description: Number of Flagsmith API tasks behind the load balancer.

dbMultiAz.title: RDS Multi-AZ
dbMultiAz.description: Keep a standby database in a second availability zone. Doubles the database cost.

domainName.title: Custom Domain
domainName.description: Optional custom domain (e.g., flags.example.com). Served over HTTPS with an ACM certificate.

hostedZoneId.title: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID
hostedZoneId.description: Hosted zone for the certificate validation and DNS records.

inviteOnly.title: Invite-only Sign-up
inviteOnly.description: Accept sign-ups only from people with an invite. Leave off for the first deploy — signing up is how you create the first account — then turn it on.

destroyDataOnDelete.title: Delete Data With the Stack
destroyDataOnDelete.description: Delete the database when the stack is deleted instead of keeping a final snapshot. Leave off unless the data is disposable.

estimatedCost.description: ~$110/mo: NAT gateway ~$33, load balancer ~$20, API task ~$21, task processor ~$11, RDS db.t4g.micro ~$14, public IPv4 addresses ~$11
